projectDescription: Speclane Studio is a meta-harness platform that unifies multiple AI agents in a single interface, enabling teams to practice specification-driven development from requirement alignment through implementation and verification.

groups.group: 会話と設定を管理する
仕様駆動開発を実践する

keyFeatures: Multiple AI agent support (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) through a unified meta-harness interface
Specification-driven development workflow from requirements to verification
Collaborative sessions with granular view/edit permissions and workspace file sharing
Session forking to explore alternative approaches with different AI agents
Import of existing AI tool conversation history into Studio sessions
Speclane-Skills: six specialized AI skill roles (speclane-creator, project-researcher, grilling, specs-creator, feature-coder, bdd-verifier)
Git-integrated change lifecycle with reflect, stage, commit, push, and pull operations
Design panel for viewing and editing specification documents alongside code
Project organization for grouping related sessions with default host/directory settings
GitHub integration for repository cloning and remote push/pull
publicApiSurface: git status / git diff --cached / git commit (user-side Git workflow)
Speclane-Skills: speclane-creator, project-researcher, grilling, specs-creator, feature-coder, bdd-verifier
Studio UI: New Chat, Agent/Model/Host selection, Work Directory, Repository Copy
Studio UI: Design panel (仕様書), Files panel (ファイル), History panel (履歴), Browser panel (ブラウザ)
Session actions: duplicate (fork), share (view/edit), import, archive
History actions: Reflect (反映), Stage (確認待ち), Commit (確定), Push (プッシュ), Pull (プル)
Settings: Appearance, Keyboard Shortcuts, Sandbox Integration (GitHub connection), Session Import
